notes: The counterpart to external-skill-reference: direct: is the one target scheme a static check can decide, and it stays an error while skill:, agent: and workflow: relaxed to warnings. The companion .md exists and carries only a heading that mentions the node rather than a section named for it, which is the stronger failure mode of the two. The document is schema-valid, so the expected keyword is a runner rule name rather than an AJV keyword; the located error is nodes.intake.uses and error_path stays at /nodes so the assertion holds whichever depth the lint reports. The graph carries no cycle, no gate and no unknown reference on purpose: those lints run first and only the first error is read.
